# mergeah_tool_pack_connector (Resource)

Manage one connector membership in a Tool Pack without changing other connectors. Destroy detaches only this connector. Do not combine with mergeah_tool_pack_connectors for the same Tool Pack or manage the same membership in multiple resources. Import existing membership using tool_pack_id/slug before managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_tool_pack_connector" "example" {
  tool_pack_id = "a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1"
  slug         = "linear"
  auth_scope   = "INDIVIDUAL"
  tool_names   = ["list_issues"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Merge API field `slug`. Changes require replacement.
- `tool_pack_id` (String) Merge API field `tool_pack_id`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `auth_scope` (String) Credential-sharing scope. When omitted, uses Merge's default for new membership and preserves the scope of existing membership.
- `tool_names` (Set of String) Exact tool selection when configured; must not be empty. When omitted, new membership enables all tools and existing membership keeps its selection. State records the returned tool names. Removing this attribute from configuration does not reset the selection to all tools; specify the desired names explicitly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_tool_pack_connector.example 'a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1/linear'
```
